title: Java 8 lambdas example
answer:
Here's an example of a Java 8 lambda expression. You can use it to sort a list of strings alphabetically.

```java
List<String> names = Arrays.asList("Alice", "Bob", "Charlie");
names.sort((s1, s2) -> s1.compareTo(s2));
System.out.println(names); // Output: [Alice, Bob, Charlie]
```

This lambda `(s1, s2) -> s1.compareTo(s2)` replaces the need for an anonymous inner class to define the `Comparator`.
